question_en: List the top 10 specs changed in Rel-18 (release change scope).
original_query: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(rel:Release {releaseName: 'Rel-18'}), (cr)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber STARTS WITH '38.1' RETURN sp.specNumber, count(cr) AS crCount ORDER BY crCount DESC LIMIT 10
reference_query: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(rel:Release {releaseName: 'Rel-18'}), (cr)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber STARTS WITH '38.1' RETURN sp.specNumber, count(cr) AS crCount ORDER BY crCount DESC LIMIT 10
